name: Injoku Densha 3
source:
I knew that molestation was bad. I knew it, but I couldn't stop it.

Eventually, though, I got fed up with the cramped interior of the train car and thought that if I was going to be in close contact with someone, it'd rather be a woman. 

And so, it didn't take long for me to start reaching out to women's bodies.
